% Converted, ltx-talk. C-DISPLAY-DOLLAR workaround: spell display math \[...\].
% This is exactly what scripts/convert_deck.py now emits -- it alternates \[ and
% \] over the $$ occurrences in file order, skipping comments and verbatim
% bodies, and refuses to rewrite at all if the count is odd.
%
% The fix is pure LaTeX with no ltx-talk dependency, so the deck stays exportable
% back to Beamer: \[...\] is correct there too (and is the form Beamer's own
% documentation uses). There is no reason to keep $$ in any deck.
%
% convert_deck.py --lint flags the before.tex form as C-DISPLAY-DOLLAR and passes
% this file clean.
